datasheet_facts.behavior: DPM limits input current or voltage; VSYSMIN reduces charging first; below that, BATFET supplement supports SYS

configuration.power_path_mode: NVDC automatic VBUS/BAT selection with BAT supplement; system load has priority over charging

reverse_power_modes.reason: ordinary SYS handover uses the integrated BATFET path; reverse VBUS/PMID generation is outside the product contract

configuration.dpm_register_contract: IINDPM range 0.1..3.3 A in 10-mA steps and VINDPM range 3.6..22 V in 100-mV steps; the protected TPS25751 image writes the selected profile and verifies masked readback before charge or RUN admission
configuration.dpm_status_contract: VINDPM_STAT and IINDPM_STAT are interrupt-driven telemetry; charge request is reduced to zero before an admitted system load is reduced, then a healthy pack may supplement SYS
configuration.temperature_control_register: REG16 TREG[1:0]=00 (60 C) and TSHUT[1:0]=11 (85 C); write and masked readback are mandatory before CE may be pulled low
configuration.reset_default: CE is pulled high; charging remains disabled until the protected TPS image has written and read back the bounded charger policy

cases.outcome: no source remains; supervisor clears RUN and rails fall monotonically to safe reset
